beats.title: Chapter 1: Find work
beats.text: Rent is due soon and your savings are thin.
Good afternoon. Your rent is due in 7 days. Will it be ready?

choices.label: I'll pay on time
choices.reply: Good. I'll expect it on Sunday.

beats.text: Welcome in. What kind of work are you looking for?

choices.label: Anything that pays this week
choices.reply: Shop and delivery jobs open every day. The shop is hiring now.

choices.label: Something with a future
choices.reply: Office jobs need more skill. The shop is a good first step.

choices.label: I'm not sure yet
choices.reply: Let's see what you can do today. The shop is hiring.

beats.text: The shop assistant job pays ₦8,000 a shift. Want me to put your name down?

choices.label: Yes, apply for me
choices.reply: Done. Mrs. Okafor will interview you at the Shop.

choices.label: Maybe later
choices.reply: No rush. Ask me again when you're ready.

beats.text: Thanks for applying. Please come to the Shop for your interview.

beats.title: Power cut
beats.text: The lights go out while you cook. Your neighbor, Mama Tunde, knocks on your door with a candle.

choices.label: Share your food
choices.result: Mama Tunde smiles and says she won't forget it.

choices.label: Stay inside
choices.result: You wait in the dark until the lights return.

flags: Stayed inside during the power cut

choices.label: Help fix the fuse
choices.result: It takes a while, but the lights come back. She tips you.

beats.text: I heard you have an interview. Take this smart jacket.
Good morning. Let's begin. Why do you want this job?
A customer is rude to you. What do you do?
Last one. Can you start on Monday?
You're hired. The job pays ₦8,000 a shift. Welcome to the team.
We'll start you on a trial week at ₦6,000 a shift, then review.
I heard it did not go well this time. The delivery rider job is open. Want it?

beats.title: Chapter 1 complete: Find work
beats.text: You have a job, and the rent is closer to being paid.
